facts.assertion: Planning Data documentation states the API provides access to over 100 planning and housing datasets for England.
A coordinate query returns entities whose geometry intersects the supplied latitude/longitude point for requested datasets.
The API accepts multiple dataset parameters in one coordinate query.
Coordinate query geometry uses WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Entity responses can include name, dataset, start-date, geometry and point fields.
Planning Data explicitly warns that absence of results does not mean no constraints exist because coverage varies by area.
The API supports polygon WKT geometry queries.
The API supports geometry_relation values including intersects, within and disjoint.
Large result sets are paginated using limit and offset.
API responses provide pre-built next, previous, first and last pagination links.
Planning Data documentation states there is no batch endpoint for portfolio point checks.
Planning Data recommends bulk downloads for hundreds of properties or more.
Bulk dataset downloads can be available as CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Parquet depending on dataset.
The Planning Data search interface currently lists Employment allocation as a dataset option.
The Planning Data search interface currently lists Development policy area as a dataset option.
